source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned comm port removes the generic ImportEnterpriseRoots:true case that expected security.enterprise_roots.enabled to be locked true. The false case remains. It does not modify production certificate import or the upstream policy engine. A later dedicated accepted test configures only ImportEnterpriseRoots:true and explicitly expects the engine to be INACTIVE. That later assertion checks engine activation rather than certificate-store contents, and it is separate from this deletion-only patch. No policy or trust operation was executed.
title: The enterprise-roots port first removes a preference-only test case
